exposure: proactive approach to infants around the limits of viability
cohort: Live-born infants (n=166) born to 137 pregnant women between 22+0/7 and 25+6/7 weeks of gestation, admitted to a single-center neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Advanced gestational age, completed antenatal corticosteroid treatment, and a proactive approach were associated with improved short-term outcomes, including decreased neonatal mortality and severe intraventricular hemorrhage, in neonates born at the limits of viability.
